verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a corporate-registry service, but the evidence documents no user-definable rules or automated actions. The only event-driven behaviour is a fixed email notice sent when corporate changes are filed. That is a built-in notification, not a user-configured rule or action, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
